description:
A demo is out now on Steam for Tempest Rising's upcoming new single-player campaign. The demo features the first two missions from the upcoming Veti story campaign, as well as the first two missions from the previous Global Defense Force and Tempest Dynasty campaigns. The demo features a peek at the Veti faction on the battlefield in skirmish mode and custom multiplayer games.

The Veti's Wrath expansion for Tempest Rising will feature the complete Veti faction, an 11-mission single-player campaign and full integration in multiplayer, skirmish mode, and custom games. The Veti's Wrath expansion for Tempest Rising will be available in 2026.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Rogue Carrier announcement trailer for this upcoming colony management game with a roguelite twist, where players are put in charge of an oceanic expedition that's stranded on a sentient and highly dangerous alien planet. The Rogue Carrier trailer showcases gameplay, your objectives, and more. Rogue Carrier will be coming to Steam Early Access, the Epic Games Store, GOG, Microsoft Store, and PC Game Pass.

Stranded amidst the endless seas of an unknown world, your expedition must scramble for supplies in a desperate fight for survival. Harvest resources from the sparse islands dotted across the surface of a harsh oceanic landscape. Power vital production chains and manage crew morale as the planet responds to your efforts with increasing threat.

Met with a deadly onslaught from both land-based fauna and clawing, thrashing horrors from the deep, play through multiple timelines as you attempt to escape this oceanic prison.
title: Rogue Carrier - Official Announcement Trailer
